svg.title: Shadow play motor target trace
svg.desc: Each panel compares commanded angle and limited target angle. This is command telemetry, not measured motor feedback.
svg.text: 10 axes | 2010 samples | 0 to 4 s | Independent angle scale for each axis
Time is controller elapsed time. Missing intervals (>3x median sample spacing) are left disconnected. Hover event bands for details.
